:Given the miraculous and nearly identical stories of Norla (supplying Cadsuaine with valuable experience and resources for what she must become) and Nakomi (pushing Aviendha in just the right direction during her second trip to Rhuidean), I believe the two of them are functionally identical. More specifically, I believe they are either

:*Avatars of the Creator
:*Manifestations of the pattern, similar to the way TAR promotes the light
:*Deus Ex Machina for the respective author (but then, if you think about it, where is the difference ;-) [[Special:Contributions/94.217.195.132|94.217.195.132]] 21:55, September 16, 2011 (UTC)


Personally I think Nakomi was a remnant of the Jenn Aiel. She is clearly Aiel, knowing too much of their traditions and speaking like one. It stands to reason that some of them may have survived and hidden near Rhuidean, and she says that she is far from her roof, yet not far at all (near Rhuidean, but she cannot go there). It is possible that she's a ghost of a Jenn Aiel, perhaps one who dwells in TAR. [[Special:Contributions/98.247.80.12|98.247.80.12]] 09:43, April 23, 2012 (UTC)

Nakomi might've appeared'' ''in the epilogue for ''A Memory of Light''. At the very start, when Rand is carrying Moridin out of the cave, he sees a woman whose voice he didn't recognize.  He sees her in "Aiel clothing", as an old woman with gray hair, which fits Nakomi's description.  Unfortunately this still doesn't tell us squat about who or what she is.
